sections.heading: What is Digital Finance?
sections.text: Digital finance uses technology to manage money online.

sections.heading: Online Banking
sections.text: Allows checking balance, transferring money, and paying bills online.

sections.heading: Mobile Payments
sections.text: Apps like UPI enable instant money transfers and payments.

sections.heading: Digital Wallets
sections.text: Store money digitally for online transactions.

sections.heading: Cryptocurrency
sections.text: Digital currency using encryption; high risk and volatility.

sections.heading: Safety Tips
sections.text:
- Use strong passwords
- Enable 2FA
- Avoid public Wi-Fi
- Never share OTP
